snippet.title: Capy of Gods — Official Trailer 🐹⚔️ (Demo Available Now)
snippet.description:
Climb an infinite tower. Slay endless hordes. Become the Capy of Gods. 🐹⚔️

Capy of Gods is a 2D pixel-art bullet hell roguelike where heroic capybaras battle through a monster-filled tower — level up, unlock loot of every rarity, face monstrous bosses, and survive... The Devourer.

🎮 FREE DEMO AVAILABLE NOW on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/TU_APP_ID/

⭐ Wishlist the game to support development!

💬 Join the community on Discord:
https://discord.gg/KsckWpZKXZ

FEATURES
- Fast-paced bullet hell + vertical platforming.
- Multiple playable capybaras with unique skills.
- Level up and build your loadout: weapons, instincts, and items of every rarity.
- 6 biomes with new creatures and quests to uncover.
- Monstrous bosses guarding every floor.
- Dark pacts, treasures, secret rooms, and more.
- Made by a solo developer (CapyEmber). Every wishlist helps a ton! ❤️
